task: M-A Human A/B Evidence Sufficiency Pilot — Design Gate

research_question.rq: 相比 E0，E1 是否能够降低 Human Reconstruction Burden、提高 Evidence Sufficiency 判断、减少因 Evidence 不完整产生的 UNCERTAIN

e0_definition.description: 上一轮 Human Validation Pilot 实际使用的旧 Evidence Pack

characteristics.60pt_rule: used for both candidate generation AND pack inclusion

S1_COMPLETE_YES.definition: E0 Pack complete + E0 judgment YES

S3_COMPLETE_UNCERTAIN.definition: E0 Pack complete + E0 judgment UNCERTAIN

S4_TYPE_A_NEGATIVE.definition: Type A negative (FIG-prefix, not near extent)

S5_TYPE_B_NEGATIVE.definition: Type B negative (near extent, no FIG-prefix)

sampling_frame.inclusion_rule: Case exists in BOTH E0 and E1 with identical CASE_ID; belongs to one of 5 strata; has rendered page image
sampling_frame.exclusion_rule: Case not in 79-case Pilot; missing page image; S_OTHER stratum

randomization_rule.method: within-stratum sort by case_id → shuffle (per-stratum seed) → take first N → shuffle (per-stratum seed) → alternating A/B → global shuffle (seed 999) for presentation

a_b_allocation.design: Parallel case split with stratified randomization
a_b_allocation.rationale: Parallel split eliminates primary carryover (same case seen twice). Counterbalanced within-subject would require 48 reviews with severe memory bias. Parallel split is minimal design controlling carryover.
a_b_allocation.secondary_carryover_note: Same Human did E0 Pilot before. Risk LOW (79 cases, reordered, Pack differs). Different Human: risk ZERO.

blinded: No GT, algorithm output, expected answer
not_blinded: Pack content differs (E1 has evidence_state, context for negatives, extent when far)
Intrinsic to design — cannot hide content differences
blinding_status.full_blinding_not_feasible: Packs differ by design; hiding content defeats experiment purpose
blinding_status.critical_bias_controlled: Human does not know which version is 'new' or 'expected to be better'

human_task.core_question: 这个文本是否与这个图形关联？(Is this text associated with this drawing?)
human_task.uncertain_followup: OPTIONAL (A: evidence insufficient, B: semantic boundary, C: other); if skipped: UNCERTAIN_UNCLASSIFIED

M5.name: TIME_TO_JUDGMENT
M5.note: UI does not record timing; do NOT fabricate

metrics.primary_comparison: RECONSTRUCTION_BURDEN_CHANGE (E0 arm vs E1 arm, descriptive only)

reconstruction_burden_definition.level_3: Must open PDF / understand page layout
reconstruction_burden_definition.level_4: Pack cannot support judgment even after PDF

evidence_sufficiency_definition.SUFFICIENT: Human believes Pack contains enough info to make Association Judgment
evidence_sufficiency_definition.INSUFFICIENT: Human believes Pack lacks necessary info
evidence_sufficiency_definition.sufficient_for_NO: Pack can be sufficient for a NO judgment
evidence_sufficiency_definition.sufficient_but_uncertain: Pack can be sufficient but judgment still UNCERTAIN (semantic boundary)

POSSIBLE_SEMANTIC_BOUNDARY.meaning: Pack complete, low burden, still uncertain

semantic_boundary_rule.critical_rule: UNCERTAIN alone does NOT mean semantic boundary

stop_rule.STOP-1: E1 Evidence Regression (any E1 field worse than E0)
stop_rule.STOP-2: E1 Modified Existing Human Data (human_session_1.json changed)
stop_rule.STOP-4: Semantic Leakage (new semantic field in Pack)
stop_rule.STOP-5: A/B Evidence Not Same Case (case_id mismatch)
stop_rule.action: Stop immediately, record condition, do NOT continue, report to user

prohibited_after: looking at partial results then modifying design

statistical_requirements.label: PILOT EVIDENCE
statistical_requirements.sample_size_justification: 24 cases sufficient for descriptive comparison and large-effect detection; NOT sufficient for significance testing

human_burden_measurement_boundary.rule: 100% completion ≠ low cognitive load; burden decreased = Document Reconstruction Burden only

hypotheses.H1: E1 arm lower PDF reopen rate (M2) than E0 arm
hypotheses.H2: E1 arm lower burden levels (M4) than E0 arm
hypotheses.H3: E1 arm higher evidence sufficiency (M6=SUFFICIENT) than E0 arm
hypotheses.H4: E1 arm fewer UNCERTAIN(EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT); UNCERTAIN(SEMANTIC_BOUNDARY) may not decrease
hypotheses.H5: E1 arm does NOT increase NO→YES leakage on S6 cases
hypotheses.note: Hypotheses tested, NOT pre-determined results. All results reported regardless of direction.

requirements: Render E0 Pack for Arm A (from reconstructed E0 data)
Render E1 Pack for Arm B (from current candidates_internal.json)
Save to NEW session file (NOT human_session_1.json)

negative_control_audit.note: A/B Pilot judgments are INDEPENDENT from E0 Pilot. Compare WITHIN A/B: Arm A vs Arm B.
